description: Retrieval test set for the IDF 2025 type 2 diabetes guidelines. Each question has an 'evidence' regex; every content page whose text (whitespace-normalised) matches it counts as a correct page. Questions are phrased the way a clinician would ask, not copied from the document.

questions.question: What HbA1c value is used to diagnose type 2 diabetes?
Which fasting plasma glucose level defines diabetes?
What fasting glucose range counts as impaired fasting glucose under the WHO criteria?
Which drug is recommended as first-line monotherapy for type 2 diabetes?
questions.evidence: [Mm]etformin remains the recommended first-line|first-line monotherapy Metformin

questions.question: What general HbA1c target do the guidelines recommend for most adults with type 2 diabetes?
What blood pressure should people with type 2 diabetes aim for?
questions.answer: <130/80 mmHg if it can be safely attained

questions.question: Which medicines are first-line for high blood pressure in people with diabetes?
questions.evidence: ACE inhibitors or ARBs are recommended

questions.question: How much exercise per week should people with type 2 diabetes aim for?
questions.answer: At least 150 minutes of moderate exercise per week

questions.question: How much weight loss should a diabetes prevention programme aim for in overweight people?
How is remission of type 2 diabetes defined?
questions.answer: HbA1c <6.5% without glucose-lowering medication for at least three months

questions.question: By how much did lifestyle intervention reduce diabetes incidence in the Diabetes Prevention Program?
How many adults were living with diabetes worldwide in 2024?
When should insulin therapy be started in type 2 diabetes?
questions.answer: When optimised glucose-lowering medications and lifestyle interventions do not maintain target control

questions.question: What kind of insulin regimen is recommended when starting insulin?
questions.answer: A single daily injection of basal insulin, continuing metformin

questions.question: Which glucose-lowering drug class is preferred for people with type 2 diabetes and heart failure?
Which tests are used to screen for chronic kidney disease in people with diabetes?
questions.evidence: Chronic Kidney Disease \(CKD\) Screening/risk assessment • eGFR • UACR

questions.question: Is continuous glucose monitoring recommended as routine care in type 2 diabetes?
questions.answer: No, it is not currently widely recommended as routine care
questions.evidence: CGM use is currently not widely recommended

questions.question: Which score is used to screen for liver fibrosis in people with type 2 diabetes and fatty liver disease?
Are statins safe in people with type 2 diabetes and fatty liver disease?
questions.evidence: Statin therapy is safe in adults with T2DM and MASLD

questions.question: Is aspirin recommended for people with type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease?
